thread:
Maya (AE): heads-up: Aurora Health wants a POC next week. They plan to test aurora-34b-clinical (q8_0 quant) with prefix KV cache + customer-managed HSM keys. Also need per-request audit logs and a compliant SLA.
Ravi (Solutions): ok. Main checklist: tokenizer/format compatibility, KV semantics, HSM integration path, and burst pricing details. @Ivy can you run a quick model-check?
Ivy (ML): running `ri model-check aurora-34b-clinical --variant q8_0 --checks tokenizer,quant,kvcache` now. ci-bot: job queued id=mc_1749994444 ETA 45s
Ivy (ML): results:
PASS tokenizer (clinical vocab BPE)
PASS quant container q8_0
PASS kv-cache semantics match prefix mode
NOTE: model uses rotary embeddings with sequence length 4096 (runtime default 2048) -> need long-seq profile or compile flag
Estimate memory per-shard ~18GB with q8_0.
Ravi (Solutions): thanks. So two follow-ups: 1) enable long-seq profile or pad/truncate, 2) confirm HSM KMS flow.
Omar (Infra): Dedicated can host; we support BYOK HSM via our KMS integration (partnered providers). For long-seq, we can compile a long-seq binary but needs a quick validation on staging. Burst is available as on-demand with ~+35% cost over reserved commit. Need expected sustained QPS to size commit.
Priya (Security): for healthcare PII, we need to ensure audit logs, field-level redaction options, and HIPAA BAAs. We can provide per-request logs with configurable retention; longer retention requires entitlements. Also HSM flow needs attestation docs — I'll share the checklist.
Noah (Legal): I'll prep BAA + updated DPA templates. We'll also need Aurora's security questionnaire.
Maya (AE): action items: Ivy to run a micro-perf on staging with long-seq enabled; Omar to provision a small Dedicated staging pool and validate KMS HSM handshake; Priya to send the security checklist; Noah to share BAA draft. Target: have a gating sign-off before POC kickoff on Tuesday.
Ivy (ML): sample perf command I'll run: `ri perf --model aurora-34b-clinical --variant q8_0 --seq 4096 --concurrency 200 --kv-prefix` I'll post numbers here.
Ravi (Solutions): also note quality check vs baseline 1) LM perplexity on 200 eval prompts 2) latency p50/p95 targets (p50 < 180ms).
Maya (AE): Aurora will aim for 5k warm sessions; Jack-in-sales will send throughput numbers. I'll update calendar after we have the perf results.
Priya (Security): sending checklist now (DM).
Ivy (ML): perf done on staging: p50=165ms, p95=310ms, token cost est ~0.0021 reserved, burst +35%. No obvious quality regressions on eval set.
Omar (Infra): KMS handshake succeeded with customer's HSM provider in staging. Sticky routing validated for KV prefix.
Maya (AE): great work team — please keep updates here and attach any artifacts.
notes: POC preflight: aurora-34b clinical variant, long-seq compile note, BYOK HSM support, burst pricing +35%, perf numbers and next steps
